title: Epistemic scope and production use of the ladder
html:
The low-order data are proved unconditionally: c_0 = 0, one-dimensional triviality, the N=1 coupling b, and the bar-even seed c_2 = -1, together with the \hbar_q-parity. The full ladder \prod_{k \geq 2}\bigl(1 + c_k^{(\lambda)} u_\lambda^k\bigr) is rigorous modulo the substrate derivation of the kernel R(q,\xi) that fixes c_k for k \geq 3. This kernel is the open s5–so_3 fibre action; the higher rungs remain conjectural pending it, and only the N \leq 2 truncation enters the calibrated mass evaluation.

For the production mass formula (\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}} = \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{p}} + \mathfrak{Q}_\beta + \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{e}}), only the N=1 envelope and the proved seed c_2 = -1 are used (derived_masses.q_beta_kashiwara_n2_mev). The higher rungs matter only for the 1\,\mathrm{ppQ} stretch target. For this target, the kernel R(q,\xi) required by the recursion is the open s5–so_3 fibre action, which is the same open input required by the absolute-mass F_{\mathrm{Bor}} term-6 Habiro tail.
